name: Hirase Tatsuya
source:
Strong libido single middle-aged salary man who always seeks pleasure in compensated dating with high school girls. After picking up Arisa by chance and getting to know about her circumstance, he grows affection to her and decides to support her.

[spoiler]When he was still student, he used to be in a band and failed to achieve his dream. Therefore, sometimes he feels conflicted about whether he should tell Arisa the truth about how hard it is for her to keep chasing her dream. Also, due to the gap of their age he is always anxious about relationship with her.[/spoiler]
